observation_policy: Identical A-D: Sapiens body/shoulders/wrists plus per-hand WiLoR 21 2D points. Fingers fixed. No predicted WiLoR 3D or triangulated loss. Views averaged; groups independently normalized.
selection: Primary seed fixed to left before runs. Secondary right seed reported separately, never GT-selected.
purpose: A single-view each camera; B shared stereo; C only doubled body hard caps with unchanged prior denominator; D only oracle betas relative to B. No alternating, no contour, no mesh-depth barrier.
